column1: # Controlled vocabulary of the N5 grid. Columns 1-11 are the lexicon schema (one row per sense; ja is the UniDic
# lemma); the grid columns after them are read by grid.py and oracle.py only.
#   gcls    grid predicate class (the pred dimension) or noun/word class: godan-u … godan-ru, godan-ku-iku, ichidan,
#           suru, kuru, sahen (noun + する; ko is the noun, the Korean verb is ko + 하다), i-adj, na-adj, noun, aru,
#           iru, noun-cop (a noun the grid also uses as a predicate), noun, pron, adn, adv, advadj, qword, counter
#   kpos    V: a non-verb glossed by a Korean verb (好き → 좋아하다, so 좋아한다, 좋아하지 않는다); - otherwise.
#           The Korean gloss, class (kcls) and ている realization (te) come from the N5 lexicon; the ko column here
#           is used only for lemmas the lexicon does not have.
#   write   the written stem used in sentences (dictionary form)
#   gflags  noimp (no request/prohibition/invitation), noteiru (no ている cell), teiru-pos (positive only with ている,
#           negative only simple: 知っている / 知らない), neg=WORD (suppletive Korean negative), time=past|future
#           (a time noun only with past / nonpast)
